assumptions: The engine decide() path is the only supersede write site (override() routes through decide(); record-tools passes supersedes into decide()) — grep for updateStatus(..."superseded") confirms no other caller.
Housekeeping loading every decision file for the scan is acceptable at field scale (staleness review already does the same).
constraints: No plugin/ changes (adoption surface shipped in plugin 1.24.1)
No commits, no version bumps, no CHANGELOG edits from this worktree
Keep decisions.ts and housekeeping.ts diffs modular — teammates crosspost-30 and archive-35 are editing the same files concurrently
context: Fixed #31 server half: superseded_by back-links now written at supersede time in both backends, surfaced by twining_why, and backfilled for historical decisions by a new housekeeping pass. TDD, 1075 tests green, build/typecheck clean.
rationale: Backfill's job is repairing the missing pointer, not relitigating lifecycle; silently retiring an active decision during housekeeping is the higher-risk action. Targets that are active despite an incoming supersedes link (re-promoted, or store-level writes) keep their status and gain the pointer.
summary: Housekeeping backfill preserves the target's current status — it writes only the missing superseded_by pointer, never flips active/archived/overridden to superseded
